programme.title: Pets / Kućni ljubimci
programme.desc: Pets - (E1800, show about pets, Croatia, 2025) In the 1800th show, we visit dog breeder Rebeka Tratnik and present the Shiba Inu and Akita Inu breeds that she breeds. Anja Andrel, breeder of Bengal cats, will introduce us to a new litter of kittens. Robert Kranjčević will present the rabbits and ornamental poultry he breeds. In the veterinary clinic, we talk about bronchopneumonia in dogs... / Kućni ljubimci - (E1800, emisija o kuć. ljub., Hrvatska, 2025) U 1800. emisiji u posjetu smo uzgajateljici pasa Rebeki Tratnik i predstavljamo pasmine shiba inu i akita inu koje uzgaja. Anja Andrel, uzgajateljica bengalskih mačaka, upoznat će nas s novim leglom mačića. Robert Kranjčević predstavit će nam kuniće i ukrasnu perad koju uzgaja. U veterinarskoj ambulanti govorimo o bronhopneumoniji kod pasa...

programme.title: DW: Tomorrow is today / DW: Sutrašnjica danas
programme.desc: Tomorrow Today - (educational program, Germany) Deutsche Welle's show about the European way of life, brings interesting things from European cities. Director: David Fisher... / Tomorrow Today - (obrazovni program, Njemačka) Emisija Deutsche Wellea o europskom načinu života, donosi zanimljivosti iz europskih gradova. R.: David Fisher...

programme.title: The world of science / Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The world of science - (educational program, Croatia, 2025) Introducing young Croatian innovators! We also take you to an interesting exhibition in London, where the dresses, jewelry and personal belongings of the French Queen Marie Antoinette will be presented at the Victoria and Albert Museum. Find out how a lone female iguana gave birth to as many as eight cubs through parthenogenesis — without mating — and how cockatoos live in the urban parks of Hong Kong... / Svijet znanosti - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Predstavljamo mlade hrvatske inovatore! Vodimo vas i na zanimljivu izložbu u Londonu, gdje će biti predstavljene haljine, nakit i osobne stvari francuske kraljice Marije Antoanete u Muzeju Victoria i Albert. Doznajte i kako je usamljena ženka iguane partenogenezom — bez parenja — okotila čak osam mladunaca te kako žive kakadui u urbanim parkovima Hong Konga...

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: Fine and wine - (educational program, Croatia) This show will talk about everything fine created by hard-working people, with an emphasis on local products, the offer of catering and accommodation services, and gastronomy and wine. We will travel through Croatia in search of inspiring stories about dedication, love for work and tradition in a contemporary guise. We will follow the successes of family farms and invite viewers to gather around the Sunday table... / Fino i vino - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Ova emisija govorit će o svemu finom što stvaraju vrijedni ljudi, s naglaskom na domaće proizvode, ponudu ugostiteljskih i smještajnih usluga te gastronomiju i vino. Putovat ćemo Hrvatskom u potrazi za nadahnjujućim pričama o posvećenosti, ljubavi prema poslu i tradiciji u suvremenom ruhu. Pratite ćemo uspjehe obiteljskih gospodarstava te gledatelje pozvati na okupljanje oko nedjeljnog stola...

programme.title: Recreation / Rekreacija
programme.desc: Recreation - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Recreation is a show dedicated to a healthy and active lifestyle and the entire lifestyle related to recreational activities. It is intended for a wider active community, with the aim of encouraging regular physical activity and health care... / Rekreacija - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Rekreacija je emisija posvećena zdravom i aktivnom načinu života te cjelokupnom lifestyleu vezanom uz rekreativne aktivnosti. Namijenjena je široj aktivnoj zajednici, s ciljem poticanja na redovitu tjelesnu aktivnost i brigu o zdravlju...

programme.title: Hotel Portofino / Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Hotel Portofino - (S03, E05, Drama, England, 2024) Natascha McElhone and Mark Umbers star in the third season of Hotel Portofino, a costume drama about a British family who run a hotel for upper-class travelers on the magical Italian Riviera in the glamorous "roaring 1920s" under the dark cloud of Fascist Italy. As Bella prepares to host her father and sister, her husband Cecil shocks her with a sudden arrival and a request for a separation. Bella must decide whether she will finally get rid of her idle husband and accept the condemnation of the public as a divorced woman in 1929. Over the course of a few weeks, Bella must make decisions about her future while juggling a strained relationship with her sister Amelia, a forbidden love with architect Marco, and the shocking return of her traumatized son Luciano, all while avoiding the local fascist leader Danioni. Bella and Cecil's life gets even more complicated after the crash of the New York Stock Exchange. Cecil has invested huge sums and they suddenly realize that they have lost almost everything. Dark secrets are revealed, old fires are rekindled and revenge is plotted - during yet another adventure in this drama set on the sun-drenched Italian Riviera of the 1920s. R.: Jon Jones Ul.: Giorgio Marchesi (Marco Bonacini), Oliver Dench (Lucian Ainsworth), Gurjeet Singh (Virat Sengupta), Olivia Morris (Alice Mays-Smith), Louis Healy (Billy Scanlon)... / Hotel Portofino - (S03, E05, igrana serija, Engleska, 2024) Natascha McElhone i Mark Umbers zvijezde su treće sezona serije Hotel Portofino, kostimirane drame o britanskoj obitelji koja drži hotel za putnike više klase na čarobnoj talijanskoj rivijeri u glamuroznim "burnim 1920-ima" pod tamnim oblakom fašističke Italije. Dok se Bella sprema ugostiti svog oca i sestru, njezin je suprug Cecil šokira iznenadnim dolaskom i zahtjevom za rastavu. Bella mora odlučiti hoće li se napokon riješiti muža besposličara i prihvatiti osudu javnosti kao rastavljena žena u 1929. godini. U razdoblju od nekoliko tjedana Bella mora donijeti odluke o budućnosti žonglirajući narušenim odnosima sa sestrom Amelijom, zabranjenom ljubavi s arhitektom Marcom te šokantnim povratkom njezina traumatizirana sina Luciana, istodobno izbjegavajući vođu mjesnih fašista Danionija. Bellin i Cecilov život zakomplicira se još više nakon sloma njujorške burze. Cecil je uložio goleme svote i oni odjednom shvate da su izgubili gotovo sve. Otkrivaju se mračne tajne, raspiruju stare vatre i planira osveta - tijekom još jedne pustolovine u ovoj drami na osunčanoj talijanskoj rivijeri 1920-ih godina. R.: Jon Jones Ul.: Giorgio Marchesi (Marco Bonacini), Oliver Dench (Lucian Ainsworth), Gurjeet Singh (Virat Sengupta), Olivia Morris (Alice Mays-Smith), Louis Healy (Billy Scanlon)...

programme.title: Hotel Portofino / Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Hotel Portofino - (S03, E06, drama series, England, 2024) On the day of the party where Claudine presents her perfume, Bella gives a presentation to Mr. Fleuryi to try to get his financial support. Cecil prepares a deadly plan against Danioni, but Jack tricks him. Lucian prepares to escape with Constance while Cecil tries to kill Danioni himself, but is caught by the Blackshirts. Bella finds out she's been granted support, Cecil is taken away, and a grieving Virat bursts into the party with a stolen gun to kill Danioni. Director: Jon Jones Street: Giorgio Marchesi (Marco Bonacini), Petar Benčić (Francesco), Mirko Soldano (Pietro), Ivan Vukelic (Black Shirt), Pasquale Esposito (Vincenzo Danioni)... / Hotel Portofino - (S03, E06, igrana serija, Engleska, 2024) Na dan zabave na kojoj Claudine predstavlja svoj parfem Bella održi prezentaciju pred g. Fleuryijem kako bi pokušala dobiti njegovu financijsku potporu. Cecil priprema smrtonosni plan protiv Danionija, ali Jack ga prevari. Lucian se sprema pobjeći s Constance dok Cecil pokušava sam ubiti Danionija, ali ga uhvate crnokošuljaši. Bella sazna da je dobila potporu, Cecila odvedu, a ožalošćeni Virat uleti na zabavu s ukradenim pištoljem kako bi ubio Danionija. programme.title: Christopher Reeve, the eternal Superman / Christopher Reeve, vječni Superman
programme.desc: Christopher Reeve, le Superman eternal - (doc. film, France, 2024) The whole world considers Christopher Reeve (1952 - 2004) to be Superman. More than 40 years after the release of Richard Donner's international hit, Christopher Reeve is still the undisputed embodiment of the superhero from Krypton. How did the American actor manage to connect the character and his name so closely? What kind of new life breathed into that hero of the novel, the embodiment of the American dream, that all actors later consider him a model for that role? Thanks to a previously unpublished interview that we managed to get just before the actor's untimely death, the film sheds light on the relationship between the two heroes, follows their development during nine years of cohabitation and afterwards, until the moment when the actor united with the superhero. R.: Philippe Guedj Ul.: Pierre Arditi (Narrator), Jim Bowers (Self), James Ivory (Self), Sandra Jennings (Self), Jenette Kahn (Self)... / Christopher Reeve, le Superman eternel - (dok. film, Francuska, 2024) Cijeli svijet Christophera Reevea (1952. - 2004.) smatra Supermanom. Više od 40 godina nakon izlaska međunarodnog filmskog hita Richarda Donnera, Christopher Reeve još je neosporno utjelovljenje superjunaka s Kriptona. Kako je Američki glumac uspio tako usko povezati lik i svoje ime? Kakav je to novi život udahnuo tom junaku romana, utjelovljenju američkog sna, da ga svi glumci poslije smatraju modelom za tu ulogu? Zahvaljujući dosad neobjavljenom intervjuu koji smo uspjeli dobiti netom prije preuranjene smrti glumca, film rasvjetljava veze između dva junaka, prati njihov razvoj tijekom devet godina suživota i nakon toga, sve do trenutka kad se glumac sjedinio sa superjunakom. R.: Philippe Guedj Ul.: Pierre Arditi (Narator), Jim Bowers (Self), James Ivory (Self), Sandra Jennings (Self), Jenette Kahn (Self)...

Each installment will explore key moments in her life on and off the field, and explore the steps that, when recalled, depict the incredible progress she has made in her career. This documentary series provides a comprehensive overview of her career, and she will tell us more from her own perspective about the important moments at the Grand Slam tournaments and the successes that marked her life in tennis. Director: Gotham Chopra Street: Serena Williams (Self), Venus Williams (Self)... / In the Arena: Serena Williams - (E02, dok. film, SAD, 2024) Nakon 27 godina bavljenja profesionalnim sportom, Serena Williams će nam u novoj osmodijelnoj dokumentarnoj seriji iz svoje perspektive prenijeti svoje najvažnije nastupe na Grand Slam turnirima i analizirati najveće uspjehe u svojoj legendarnoj karijeri. Svaki nastavak istražit će ključne trenutku u njezinu životu na terenu, ali i izvan njega, te istražiti korake koje, kad ih se prisjeti, oslikavaju nevjerojatan napredak koji je ostvarila u karijeri. Ova dokumentarna serija donosi sveobuhvatan prikaz njezine karijere, a ona će nam sama iz svoje perspektive reći više o važnim trenucima na Grand Slam turnirima i uspjesima koji su obilježili njezin život u tenisu. programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S10, E17, Comedy, USA, 2023) Once upon a time, not so long ago, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) used his parents' video camera to document life on the outskirts of the 1980s. He has his hands full, starting with well-meaning but stifling mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), to temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orrantia) and hypersensitive brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And then there is the unbelted grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when there are better things in life. Driving lessons, first jobs, college applications, and making new friends without losing old ones are all part of the Goldberg family saga. Some leave their childhood behind in search of their first kiss, others struggle with raising teenagers or, faced with aging, recall youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience it all. For better or for worse, they are always there for each other. R.: Lea Thompson St.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)... / The Goldbergs - (S10, E17, komedija, SAD, 2023) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. programme.title: Room for Nenad / Soba za Nenada
programme.desc: Room for Nenada - (doc. film, Croatia, 2023) Documentary film about the legacy of the famous and favorite Croatian architect Stjepan Planić, as a culture of housing, the impact of architecture on the daily life of the families who were his investors and those who still live in his premises, as well as on the dynamics of relationships and socializing within the community. Throughout the film, we follow the testimonies of several people who were connected to Planić in different ways, this is a film about them as well. Several people of different generations are having fun in a villa in Samobor. They remember the legacy left to them by the famous Croatian architect Stjepan Planić. In addition to living in houses designed by him, they are connected even more strongly by the most important element of Planić's legacy - togetherness and companionship. People associated with him and his projects are still around today, forty years after his death, and they leave the same values ​​as a legacy to new generations. Director: Ivana Karačonji Rupčić... / Soba za Nenada - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Dokumentarni film o naslijeđu poznatog i omiljenog hrvatskog arhitekta Stjepana Planića, kao kulture stanovanja, utjecaja arhitekture na svakodnevni život obitelji koje su bile njegovi investitori i onih koji i danas žive u njegovim prostorima pa i na dinamiku odnosa i druženja unutar zajednice. Kroz film pratimo svjedočanstva nekoliko osoba koje su na različite načine bile povezane s Planićem, ovo je film i o njima. U jednoj samoborskoj vili zabavlja se nekoliko ljudi različitih naraštaja. Prisjećaju se naslijeđa koje im je ostavio poznati hrvatski arhitekt Stjepan Planić. Osim što žive u kućama koje je on projektirao, još ih jače povezuje najvažnija stavka Planićevog naslijeđa - zajedništvo i druženje. Ljudi povezani s njim i njegovim projektima nalaze se i danas, četrdeset godina nakon njegove smrti te ostavljaju iste vrijednosti u naslijeđe i novim generacijama. R.: Ivana Karačonji Rupčić...

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative break and space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon... / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona...

programme.title: A delicacy / Delicija
programme.desc: Delicieux - (film, France, 2021) At the dawn of the French Revolution, Pierre Manceron, a daring and proud chef, is fired by his master, the Duke of Chamfort. An encounter with an incredible woman, who wants to learn culinary skills from him, restores his self-confidence and encourages him to emancipate himself and start a personal revolution. Together, the two will design a place for socializing and enjoying culinary specialties open to all: the first restaurant. That idea will bring them clients... and enemies. Director: Eric Besnard Street: Gregory Gadebois (Pierre Manceron), Isabelle Carre (Louise), Benjamin Lavernhe (Le duc de Chamfort), Guillaume de Tonquedec (Hyacinthe - lintentant), Christian Bouillette (Jacob)... / Delicieux - (film, Francuska, 2021) U osvit Francuske revolucije, Pierrea Mancerona, odvažnog i ponosnog kuhara, otpušta njegov gospodar, vojvoda Chamfort. Susret s nevjerojatnom ženom, koja od njega želi naučiti kulinarsko umijeće, vraća mu samopouzdanje i potiče ga da se emancipira i pokrene osobnu revoluciju. Njih će dvoje zajedno osmisliti mjesto druženja i uživanja u kulinarskim specijalitetima otvoreno za sve: prvi restoran. Ta će im ideja donijeti klijente... i neprijatelje. R.: Eric Besnard Ul.: Gregory Gadebois (Pierre Manceron), Isabelle Carre (Louise), Benjamin Lavernhe (Le duc de Chamfort), Guillaume de Tonquedec (Hyacinthe - lintendant), Christian Bouillette (Jacob)...

programme.title: Klapa Cesarica concert - 30 years of activity / Koncert Klape Cesarice - 30 godina djelovanja
programme.desc: Klapa Cesarica concert - 30 years of activity - (show magazine, Croatia, 2023) In November 2023, Zagreb's longest-running female singing group "Cesarice" celebrated its thirtieth anniversary of activity. In the Kerempuh Theater, nine Empresses presented themselves with songs, from Dalmatian folk to Macedonian, Ukrainian and Japanese songs... They were accompanied by guitarist Tamara Perc, percussionist and drummer Borna Šercar and Ivan Judaš on handpan. R.: Grgić Company... / Koncert Klape Cesarice - 30 godina djelovanja - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2023) Najdugovječnija zagrebačka ženska pjevačka klapa "Cesarice" obilježila je u studenom 2023. tridesetu obljetnicu djelovanja. U Kazalištu Kerempuh devet Cesarica predstavilo se pjesmama, od dalmatinskih narodnih do makedonske, ukrajinske i japanske pjesme... Pratili su ih gitaristica Tamara Perc, udaraljkaš i bubnjar Borna Šercar i na handpanu Ivan Judaš.Odjel Glazbenih sadržaja HRT-a priredio je snimku, jednog sasvim posebnog koncerta, posebnog za ljubitelje ženske klapske pjesme. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: Great shipwrecks of the Adriatic / Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: Great shipwrecks of the Adriatic - (E03, doc. series, Croatia, 2007) During 1944, the German army had a strong naval force in the Adriatic, the backbone of which was formed by flotillas of fast and well-armed torpedo boats. They were equipped with strong torpedo armament and intended to attack slower enemy ships. They were also used for other purposes - escorting transport ships, laying minefields, and for defense against submarines and allied light naval forces. This is the story of two twin ships - the Italian torpedo boats TA 36 Stella Polare and TA 45 Spica, which the Germans completed in our shipyards and immediately included them in dangerous war tasks in the most difficult days of the German struggle for survival in the Adriatic. TA 36 sank in the northern Adriatic after only two months of sailing, encountering a sea mine, while TA 45 perished in the last naval conflict with the Allies, becoming a victim of the modern technology at the disposal of the Allies - radar. Director: Davor Šarić... / Veliki brodolomi Jadrana - (E03, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2007) Njemačka je vojska tijekom 1944. godine na Jadranu raspolagala jakim pomorskim snagama, čiju su okosnicu činile flotile brzih i dobro naoružanih torpiljarki. Bile su opremljene jakim torpednim naoružanjem i namijenjene za napad na sporije neprijateljske brodove. Korištene su i za drugu namjenu - pratnja transportnih brodova, polaganje minskih polja, te za obranu od podmornica i savezničkih lakih pomorskih snaga. Ovo je priča o dva broda blizanca - talijanskim torpiljarkama TA 36 Stella Polare i TA 45 Spica koje su Nijemci dovršili u našim brodogradilištima i odmah ih uključili u opasne ratne zadatke u najtežim danima njemačke borbe za opstanak na Jadranu. TA 36 potonula je u sjevernom Jadranu nakon samo dva mjeseca plovidbe, nailaskom na morsku minu, dok je TA 45 nastradala u posljednjem pomorskom sukobu sa Saveznicima, postavši žrtvom suvremene tehnologije kojom je raspolagala saveznička strana - radara. R.: Davor Šarić...

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Notes on language - (educational program, Croatia) In the last few decades, English has become somehow close to everyone. We listen to it all the time, so it gets into our ears no matter how we say it. In order to better understand it, today we will show its historical development, which is most closely connected with the history of the British island. How did the Celts, Romans, Vikings, Danes, Germans, French influence its development? What is the origin of today's English vocabulary, is there an English standard language and how is it determined? English speaker Dora Maček speaks in the show. Director: Goran Ribarić... / Bilješke o jeziku - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Engleski je u posljednjih nekoliko desetljeća postao svima nekako blizak. Stalno ga slušamo pa uđe u uho bez obzira kako ga govorimo. Kako bismo ga bolje razumjeli, danas ćemo pokazati njegov povijesni razvitak koji je najuže povezan s poviješću britanskog otoka. Kako su na njegov razvoj utjecali Kelti, Rimljani, Vikinzi, Danci, Nijemci, Francuzi? Koje je podrijetlo današnjeg engleskog vokabulara, postoji li engleski standardni jezik i kako se određuje? U emisiji govori anglistica Dora Maček. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: Sound collector / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sound Collector - (E51, feature series, Croatia) Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little being spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are most often the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle... / Skupljač zvukova - (E51, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S09, E06, animated series, USA, 2022) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Nylan Parthipan (Al), Jackson Reid (Rocky)... / PAW Patrol - (S09, E06, anim. serija, SAD, 2022) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Nylan Parthipan (Al), Jackson Reid (Rocky)...

programme.title: Time for Timmy / Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy Time - (S02, E03, animated series, England, 2009) The animated British children's series follows the adventures of a little troubled lamb and his friends. Timmy goes to kindergarten in the hills where teacher Harriet and teacher Osbourne teach him how to be a good friend and how to share with friends. In addition, it is important that students accept their mistakes and learn something from them. Join Timmy and his friends - Yabba the duck, Paxton the pig and Mittens the kitten as they sing, play and laugh. Director: Jackie Cockle... / Timmy Time - (S02, E03, anim. serija, Engleska, 2009) Animirana britanska dječja serija prati avanture malog problematičnog janjeta i njegovih prijatelja. Timmy ide u vrtić u brdima gdje ga učiteljica Harriet i učitelj Osbourne uče kako da bude dobar prijatelj te kako s prijateljima treba dijeliti. Osim toga važno je da učenici prihvaćaju svoje pogreške i na njima nešto nauče. Pridružite se Timmyju i njegovim prijateljima - patki Yabbi, praščiću Paxtonu i mačiću Mittensu u njihovoj pjesmi, igri i smijehu. R.: Jackie Cockle...

programme.title: Kreki / Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki - (children's program, Croatia, 2023) Krceki are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game are also waiting for you!... / Krceki - (dječji program, Hrvatska, 2023) Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!...

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Krceki - song - (E26, children's program, Croatia) Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramezljlko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the series Krceki... / Krceki - pjesmica - (E26, dječji program, Hrvatska) Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki...

programme.title: Lu and colorful company / Lu i šareno društvo
programme.desc: Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E12, cartoon series, Ireland, 2023) Lu is a little ladybug who has just started preschool with her new friends, and is entering a completely new social life. This animated dramedy for preschoolers takes place in Bubingrad, a small village that is home to a community of bugs. Lu's teacher Mila is a snail, and Lu goes to school in a house on her back. Lu and her new friends, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica and Maks, build their first friendships and at the same time learn social skills in order to navigate them! The series explores the fun, drama and mishaps that come from the lives of preschoolers. Filled with music, humor and heart, Lu and the merry band celebrate their friendships. R.: Nicky Phelan Ul.: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Shella), Alice Helenport (Elodie), Kolby McDonald (Gus), Donncha ODea (Lus Dad)... / Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E12, crt. serija, Irska, 2023) Lu je mala bubamara koja je upravo krenula u predškolu sa svojim novim prijateljima, te ulazi u sasvim novi društveni život. Ova animirana dramedija za predškolarce događa se u Bubingradu, malom selu koje je dom zajednici buba. Luina učiteljica Mila je puž, te Lu odlazi u školu u kućici na njezinim leđima. Lu i njezini novi prijatelji, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica i Maks, grade svoja prva prijateljstva te usto uče društvene vještine kako bi se u njima snašli! Serija istražuje zabavu, dramu i nezgode koje proizlaze iz života predškolaraca. Ispunjeni glazbom, humorom i srcem, Lu i vesela družina slave svoja prijateljstva. R.: Nicky Phelan Ul.: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Shella), Alice Helenport (Elodie), Kolby McDonald (Gus), Donncha ODea (Lus Dad)...

programme.title: Hi Day / Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Hey Duggee - (S03, E08, cartoon series, England) Get ready for laughter, learning and exciting activities in an adventure-filled club that every child will want to join! Meet Duggee, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages kids to have fun, be full of energy and most of all, do anything! Each episode of this colorful, fun and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Duggee welcoming the Chipmunks, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there's laughter and learning as the Chipmunks discover something new about the world around them, and Duggee watches over them patiently. Their adventures are often funny and comical, which will certainly attract young viewers (as well as adults) and encourage them to solve problems actively and on the move, running and jumping. Duggee rewards club members with an activity badge each time, which they proudly show off to the parents who pick them up at the end of each episode. Introducing... Squirrels! Piko, a small and good-natured rhinoceros, a gentle soul who often gets lost in the things around him! Betty, a cheerful octopus who loves to read and is very intelligent, wants to be the first to answer every question. Vrcko, a hyperactive hippopotamus who approaches everything with enthusiasm, is loud and doesn't like listening. Lucky, a small, happy and undemanding crocodile, will use every opportunity to get wet. Nora, thoughtful and smart muscle, is sensitive, curious and gentle. R.: Grant Orchard St.: Alexander Armstrong (Narrator), Jasmine Bartholomew (Betty), Alfie Sanderson (Tag), Poppy Boyes (Norrie), Duke Davis (Happy)... / Hey Duggee - (S03, E08, crt. serija, Engleska) Pripremite se na smijeh, učenje i uzbudljive aktivnosti u klubu punom pustolovina kojem će se svako dijete htjeti pridružiti! Upoznajte Duggeeja, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i više od svega, da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene, zabavne i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Duggee dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Duggee strpljivo pazi na njih. Njihove pustolovine često su šaljive i komične, što će zasigurno privući mlade gledatelje (ali i odrasle) i potaknuti ih da probleme rješavaju aktivno i u pokretu, trčeći i poskakujući. Duggee svaki put članove kluba nagradi značkom za aktivnost, što oni ponosno pokazuju roditeljima koji dođu po njih na kraju svake epizode. Predstavljamo... Vjeverice! Piko, malen i dobrodušan nosorog, nježna duša koja se često zalijeće u stvari oko sebe! Beti, vesela hobotnica koja voli čitati i vrlo je inteligentna, želi odgovoriti prva na svako pitanje. Vrcko, hiperaktivan vodenkonj koji svemu pristupa s oduševljenjem, glasan je i ne ide mu slušanje. Srećko, malen, sretan i nezahtjevan krokodil, iskoristit će svaku priliku da se smoči. Nora, zamišljena i pametna mišica, osjećajna je, radoznala i nježna. R.: Grant Orchard Ul.: Alexander Armstrong (Narator), Jasmine Bartholomew (Betty), Alfie Sanderson (Tag), Poppy Boyes (Norrie), Duke Davis (Happy)...

programme.title: Pancake song / Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Pancake song - (children's program, Croatia) Sing and dance to the new Pancake song. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time... / Pjesmica Palačinke - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E50, Drama, Australia) Bluey is a sweet and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E50, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E11, feature series, England, 2023) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E11, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke
programme.desc: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's - (S01, E18, drama series, Croatia) PEPE, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka Puppet drama series A series for the youngest about going to the doctor. Her main characters are Pepe, Bubi and Lu, little ones who are still growing their milk teeth. They are a little mischievous and very afraid of doctors and injections, but with dear doctor Zdravka and funny uncle Boža, they will master all the lessons and overcome their fear of the doctor's office. Three fun songs await you in the series!... / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke - (S01, E18, igrana serija, Hrvatska) PEPE, BUBI I LU kod dr. Zdravke Lutkarska igrana serija Serija za najmlađe o odlasku liječniku. Njezini su glavni junaci Pepe, Bubi i Lu, mališani kojima još rastu mliječni zubi. Malo su nestašni i jako se boje doktora i injekcije, ali uz dragu doktoricu Zdravku i smiješnog ujaka Božu savladat će sve lekcije i pobijediti strah od ordinacije. U serijalu vas očekuju i tri zabavne pjesmice!...

programme.title: Oggy Oggy / Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy - (S01, E20, feature series, France, 2021) Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri, The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys... / Oggy Oggy - (S01, E20, igrana serija, Francuska, 2021) Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka...

programme.title: The song Red / Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Pjesmica Crvena - (children's program, Croatia) Crvena We will go on a winter walk and learn about the magic of the color red... / Pjesmica Crvena - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (S01, E26, drama series, England) The series "Number Blocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily... / Numberblocks - (S01, E26, igrana serija, Engleska) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke...

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E46, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. R.: Mark Baker St.: John Sparkes (Narrator)... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E46, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s puno ljudskih osobina. Uz nju, tu su još njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Peppini prijatelji su njezinih godina, dok su prijatelji njezinog mlađeg brata njegovi vršnjaci. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. Likovi u seriji nose odjeću, žive u kućama i voze automobile, no pokazuju i neke osobine onih životinja na kojima su temeljeni. R.: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (Narator)...

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E18, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E18, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. R.: Julien Cayot Ul.: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)...

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: 123 Number Squad - (E33, drama series, Singapore, 2021) Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. R.: Sacha Goedegebure St.: Owen Crouch (Maurice / Redbeard), Marlon Dance-Hooi (Mr. Mengo / Farmer Haywire), Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)... / 123 Number Squad - (E33, igrana serija, Singapur, 2021) Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123. R.: Sacha Goedegebure Ul.: Owen Crouch (Maurice / Redbeard), Marlon Dance-Hooi (Mr. Mengo / Farmer Haywire), Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)...

programme.title: The best day / Najbolji dan
programme.desc: The best day - (E05, children's program, Croatia) Iskra is an ordinary girl and like children her age, she likes cartoons, games and sweets. What distinguishes her from her peers is her long red hair. Her sister Stella is also red-haired. Iskra is overjoyed when they go on trips with Stella and her parents because she enjoys nature, likes hiking and fishing on the lakes. She goes to school accompanied by her parents, but she also looks forward to the day when she will start going alone. He wants to try as soon as possible, but for the first time in the company of DigiDigi. R.: Jakov Nola... / Najbolji dan - (E05, dječji program, Hrvatska) Iskra je obična djevojčica i poput djece njezine dobi voli crtiće, igru i slatkiše. Ono što ju razlikuje od vršnjaka je duga riđa kosa. Riđokosa je i njezina seka Stela. Iskra je presretna kad sa Stelom i roditeljima putuju na izlete jer uživa u prirodi, voli planinariti i pecati na jezerima. U školu ide u pratnji roditelja, ali se i veseli danu kad će početi ići sama. Želi što prije pokušati, ali prvi put u društvu DigiDigija. R.: Jakov Nola...

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Love Monster - (E53, cartoon series, England, 2021) Follow the unforgettable adventures of this little monster who lives in a town full of cute little animals. The love monster may not look like the others, but despite that, his friends love him and go on crazy adventures with him. R.: Rufus Blacklock Ul.: Darren Foreman (Love Monster), Tamsin Greig (Narrator), Javone Prince (Bad Idea Puppy), Sarah Hadland (Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny)... / Love Monster - (E53, crt. serija, Engleska, 2021) Pratite nezaboravne avanture ovog malenog čudovišta koje živi u gradu prepunom mali slatkih životinjica. Ljubavno čudovište možda ne izgleda kao ostali, ali usprkos tome njegovi ga prijatelji vole i odlaze s njim na lude pustolovine. R.: Rufus Blacklock Ul.: Darren Foreman (Love Monster), Tamsin Greig (Narrator), Javone Prince (Bad Idea Puppy), Sarah Hadland (Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny)...

programme.title: Bitz i Bob / Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob - (E38, feature series, England, 2018) In the children's series Bitz and Bob, we follow the adventures of the girl inventor Bitz and her younger brother Bob. She embodies the new strong girl and is fascinated by all innovative things and activities related to science, technology, art and mathematics. The goal of this series is to encourage girls and boys to do their own research, to be ambitious and to come up with different ways to solve any problem. Director: Angela Russel Street: Rob Delaney (Bevel)... / Bitz and Bob - (E38, igrana serija, Engleska, 2018) U dječjoj seriji Bitz i Bob pratimo dogodovštine djevojčice izumiteljice Bitz i njezinog mlađeg brata Boba. Ona utjelovljuje novu snažnu djevojku i fasciniraju je sve inovativne stvari i aktivnosti vezane za znanost, tehnologiju, umjetnost i matematiku. Cilj ove serije je poticanje djevojčica i dječaka da sami istražuju, da budu ambiciozni i osmišljavaju razne načine s ciljem da riješe bilo koji problem. R.: Angela Russel Ul.: Rob Delaney (Bevel)...

programme.title: It's at the hotel / Ho ho ho hotel
programme.desc: Ho ho ho hotel - (E10, children's program, Croatia) HO HO HO HOTEL This fall, we invite you to a hotel like you've never seen before! What kind of guests will be welcomed by the best and funniest hosts of Hotel Ruža i Franc and what funny, silly and impossible wishes and problems will be faced by their guests - you will see in 20 episodes of the new humorous and educational series for children! Ruža and Franc can solve any problem, but in their own special and funny way. Dramatic-educational series of 20 ten-minute episodes produced by the Program for Children and Young People takes place in a hotel with the most unusual, best and sweetest hosts Ruža and Franco and their guests with even more unusual crazy wishes and problems! Through the funny and silly incidents of a clumsy magician, a silly scientist, an opera diva who lost her voice and many others, we will learn what is warm and what is cold, what is quiet and what is loud, fast or slow, big or small, high or low, near or far, heavy or light, visible or invisible! R.: Marko Šantić Ul.: Jadranka Đokić (Ruža), Borko Perić (Franc)... / Ho ho ho hotel - (E10, dječji program, Hrvatska) HO HO HO HOTEL Ove vas jeseni pozivamo u hotel kakav još nikada niste vidjeli! Kakve će sve goste dočekati najbolji i i najzabavniji domaćini Hotela Ruža i Franc i koje će smiješne, šašave i nemoguće želje i probleme imati njihovi gosti- vidjet ćete u 20 epizoda nove humoristično- edukativne serije za djecu ! Ruža i Franc mogu riješiti svaki problem, ali , na a svoj posebni i smiješni način. Igrano- edukativna serija od 20 desetominutnih epizoda u produkciji Programa za djecu i mlade događa se u hotelu s najneobičnijim, najboljim i najsješnijim domaćinima Ružom i Francom te njihovim gostima s još neobičnijim luckastim željama i problemima! Kroz smiješne i šašave zgode nespretnog mađioničara, šašavog znanstvenika, operne dive koja je ostala bez glasa i mnogih drugih, naučit ćemo što je toplo, a što hladno, što tiho, a što glasno, brzo ili sporo, veliko il malo, visoko i nisko, blizu ili daleko, teško ili lagano, vidljivo ili nevidljivo! R.: Marko Šantić Ul.: Jadranka Đokić (Ruža), Borko Perić (Franc)...

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: The song "I'll do it all alone" - (children's program, Croatia) In the humorous song "I'll do it all alone" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own - without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message - that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time!... / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami - bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku - da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (E01, feature series, England, 2021) The series "Numberblocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. Street: Beth Chalmers (Three / One), Teresa Gallagher (Six), David Holt (Seven), Marcel McCalla (Two), Emma Tate (Twenty-One)... / Numberblocks - (E01, igrana serija, Engleska, 2021) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke. Ul.: Beth Chalmers (Three / One), Teresa Gallagher (Six), David Holt (Seven), Marcel McCalla (Two), Emma Tate (Twenty-One)...

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Dino Ranch - (S02, E31, Drama, Canada, 2022) When Thunderbirds attack Clover and Mina's sleepover at the Kennel, Clover's plans for a quiet night are disrupted by a playful little spinosaur. Clover is excited about a sleepover with little watermelons, but is surprised when Gazigrom and his daughter Gazigromica appear, who ask her to join them. Min lets her participate, but the little spinosaur is a real temptation and disrupts all of Clover's quiet and gentle games that he has prepared for himself and the other minions. Clover eventually gets so upset that she sends Thunderbird to the corner for punishment, which makes her so sad that she throws a true spinosaurian tantrum, running and crying all over the ranch. Clover feels terrible and realizes that Gazigromica just wanted to play with others. He quickly finds a way to adapt his games so she can participate too, stopping her tears and turning the sleepover into a real success! R.: Trevor Deane-Freeman Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)... / Dino Ranch - (S02, E31, igrana serija, Kanada, 2022) Kad Gromgromica bane na Cloverov i Minin prespavanac u Uzgajalištu, Cloverovi planovi za mirnu noć poremete se zbog razigrane male spinosaurice. Clover je uzbuđen zbog prespavanca s malim dinićima, no iznenadi se kad se pojave Gazigrom i njegova kći Gazigromica, koji zamole da im se i ona pridruži. Min dopusti da sudjeluje, ali mala spinosaurica je prava napast i poremeti sve Cloverove tihe i nježne igre koje je pripremio za sebe i druge diniće. Clover se naposljetku toliko uzruja da pošalje Gromgromicu u kut za kaznu, a nju to toliko rastuži da dobije pravi spinosaurski napadaj bijesa, trčeći i plačući po cijelome ranču. Clover se osjeća užasno i shvati da se Gazigromica samo htjela igrati s drugima. Brzo pronađe način da prilagodi svoje igre kako bi i ona mogla sudjelovati, čime zaustavi njezine suze i pretvori prespavanac u pravi uspjeh! R.: Trevor Deane-Freeman Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)...

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: The Furchester Hotel - (S03, E08, Drama, England) Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (a BBC pre-school program). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel... / The Furchester Hotel - (S03, E08, igrana serija, Engleska) Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela...

programme.title: Superteta / Superteta
programme.desc: SuperTeta - (children's program, Croatia) We know that you know all kinds of super heroes! And we know that all of them are great! But we are sure that you still haven't met SuperTeta - a truly special superheroine who helps only and only children! Especially for kindergarteners! Because in their exciting and interesting kindergarten days, there is always a moment when they need a "little" help, a solution to a problem, or sometimes just another friend in the game in playing, having fun, learning or realizing their wonderfully interesting ideas! And that's where SuperTeta enters the scene and into their kindergarten stories! She creates, works, consoles... may she solve every problem! It's enough for her to snap her fingers, tap her heels... touch this or that and... start the magic of joint play, fun and creation... And to ensure that every SuperAunt's kindergarten story is told beautifully and accurately, Jura, the most curious caterpillar you've ever met, will make sure!!! Director: Ivana Radovčić... / SuperTeta - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Znamo da poznajete najrazličitije super junake! I znamo da su svi od reda super! Ali smo sigurni da još uvijek niste upoznali SuperTetu - uistinu posebnu superjunakinju koja pomaže samo i jedino djeci! Osobito vrtićarcima! Jer u njihovim uzbudljivim i zanimljivim vrtićkim danima uvijek se dogodi trenutak kada u igri, zabavi, učenju ili ostvarivanju njihovih čudesno zanimljivih ideja zatrebaju "malu" pomoć, rješenje problema ili ponekad samo još jednog druga u igri! I tu na scenu i u njihove vrtićke priče stupa SuperTeta! Ona stvara, radi, tješi... ma ona svaki problem riješi! Dovoljno je da pucne prstima, lupi petama... dotakne ovo ili ono i... pokrene čaroliju zajedničke igre, zabave i stvaranja... A da bi svaka SuperTetina vrtićka priča bila lijepo i točno ispričana, pobrinut će se Jura, najznatiželjnija gusjenica koju ste ikad upoznali!!! R.: Ivana Radovčić...

programme.title: A colorful pot / Šareni lonac
programme.desc: Šareni lonac - (parody, Croatia) Šareni lonac is a show in which children cook. Little chefs are helpers of famous chefs Hrvoje Krajnović and Mario Mihelj and pastry chef Mateja Krvarić. In Šareni lonc, appetizers, main dishes and desserts are prepared, but in a completely new way, with games and fun. Take a look at the Colorful Pot! R.: Petar Orešković... / Šareni lonac - (parodija, Hrvatska) Šareni lonac je emisija u kojoj djeca kuhaju. Mali kuhari pomagači su poznatih kuhara Hrvoja Krajnovića i Maria Mihelja te slastičarke Mateje Krvarić. U Šarenom loncu pripremaju se predjela, glavna jela i deserti, ali na jedan potpuno nov način, uz igru i zabavu. Zavirite u Šareni lonac! R.: Petar Orešković...

programme.title: Daniel the tiger's neighborhood / Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E15, Drama, USA) "Daniel Tigers Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." The series tells inspiring stories about the lives of preschoolers, using musical strategies rooted in Fred Rogers' famous social-emotional learning. Through imagination, creativity and music, Daniel and his friends learn important social skills, necessary for school and life. The main character of the series is Tigrić Daniel (son of Mama Tigrica and Papa Tigra). Along with him, the series also features other children, characters from the Neighborhood of Imagination, such as Maca Katarina (daughter of Maca Henrietta), Miss Elena (daughter of Lady Elena Fairchilda and Niko Musician), Owl O (nephew of Owl X) and Prince Wednesday (youngest son of King Friday and Queen Saturday, younger brother of Prince Tuesday). Each episode consists of two parts connected by a common social-emotional theme, such as disappointment and sadness or anger and gratitude. Each of the stories is accompanied by appropriate musical numbers, in order to bring the theme and different life situations as close as possible to the youngest viewers. Street: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)... / Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E15, igrana serija, SAD) "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa". Serija pripovijeda poticajne priče o životu predškolske djece, služeći se glazbenim strategijama ukorijenjenim u poznatom socijalno-emotivnom učenju Freda Rogersa. Kroz maštu, kreativnost i glazbu, Daniel i njegovi prijatelji uče važne društvene vještine, neophodne za školu i život. Glavni lik serije je Tigrić Daniel (sin Mame Tigrice i Tate Tigra). Uz njega, u seriji se također pojavljuju druga djeca, likovi iz Susjedstva Mašte, kao što su Maca Katarina (kći Mace Henrijete), gospođica Elena (kći ledi Elene Fairchilde i Nika Glazbenika), Sova O (nećak Sove X) i Princ Srijeda (najmlađi sin Kralja Petka i Kraljice Subote, mlađi brat Princa Utorka). Svaka epizoda sastoji se iz dva dijela povezana zajedničkom socijalno-emotivnom temom, kao što su razočarenje i tuga ili bijes i zahvalnost. Svaku od priča prate i prigodni glazbeni brojevi, kako bi se najmlađim gledateljima što bolje približila tema i različite životne situacije. Ul.: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)...

Serija pripovijeda poticajne priče o životu predškolske djece, služeći se glazbenim strategijama ukorijenjenim u poznatom socijalno-emotivnom učenju Freda Rogersa. Kroz maštu, kreativnost i glazbu, Daniel i njegovi prijatelji uče važne društvene vještine, neophodne za školu i život. Glavni lik serije je Tigrić Daniel (sin Mame Tigrice i Tate Tigra). Uz njega, u seriji se također pojavljuju druga djeca, likovi iz Susjedstva Mašte, kao što su Maca Katarina (kći Mace Henrijete), gospođica Elena (kći ledi Elene Fairchilde i Nika Glazbenika), Sova O (nećak Sove X) i Princ Srijeda (najmlađi sin Kralja Petka i Kraljice Subote, mlađi brat Princa Utorka). Svaka epizoda sastoji se iz dva dijela povezana zajedničkom socijalno-emotivnom temom, kao što su razočarenje i tuga ili bijes i zahvalnost. Svaku od priča prate i prigodni glazbeni brojevi, kako bi se najmlađim gledateljima što bolje približila tema i različite životne situacije. Ul.: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)...

programme.title: Pancake song / Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Pancake song - (children's program, Croatia) Sing and dance to the new Pancake song. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time... / Pjesmica Palačinke - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E50, Drama, Australia) Bluey is a sweet and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E50, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E11, feature series, England, 2023) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E11, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke
programme.desc: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's - (S01, E18, drama series, Croatia) PEPE, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka Puppet drama series A series for the youngest about going to the doctor. Her main characters are Pepe, Bubi and Lu, little ones who are still growing their milk teeth. They are a little mischievous and very afraid of doctors and injections, but with dear doctor Zdravka and funny uncle Boža, they will master all the lessons and overcome their fear of the doctor's office. Three fun songs await you in the series!... / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke - (S01, E18, igrana serija, Hrvatska) PEPE, BUBI I LU kod dr. Zdravke Lutkarska igrana serija Serija za najmlađe o odlasku liječniku. Njezini su glavni junaci Pepe, Bubi i Lu, mališani kojima još rastu mliječni zubi. Malo su nestašni i jako se boje doktora i injekcije, ali uz dragu doktoricu Zdravku i smiješnog ujaka Božu savladat će sve lekcije i pobijediti strah od ordinacije. U serijalu vas očekuju i tri zabavne pjesmice!...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (S01, E26, drama series, England) The series "Number Blocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily... / Numberblocks - (S01, E26, igrana serija, Engleska) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke...

programme.title: I love animals / Volim životinje
programme.desc: I love animals - (E05, doc. series, Croatia, 2019) Twelve-year-old Ivor has two parrots, nymphs from the cockatoo family. For his tenth birthday, he got the nymph Rikica, and so that she wouldn't be lonely, the parrot Tito also came to their home. Ivor is attached to his parrots, he writes homework, studies and plays with them, but he also enjoys when the female Rikica sings to the male Tito. When Rikica stops singing due to changing feathers, all the housemates are worried. After a long period without a song, it will be a challenge for Ivor to persuade the musical Rikica to sing again... / Volim životinje - (E05, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2019) Dvanaestogodišnji Ivor ima dvije papige, nimfe iz porodice kakadua. Za deseti rođendan dobio je nimfu Rikicu, a da ne bi bila usamljena, u njihov dom došao je i papagaj Tito. Ivor je vezan uz svoje papige, s njima piše zadaću, uči i igra se, ali i uživa kad ženka Rikica pjeva mužjaku Titu. Kad Rikica prestane pjevati zbog mijenjanja perja, svi su ukućani zabrinuti. Nakon dužeg razdoblja bez pjesme, Ivoru će biti izazov nagovoriti muzikalnu Rikicu da ponovno zapjeva...

programme.title: The song Red / Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Pjesmica Crvena - (children's program, Croatia) Crvena We will go on a winter walk and learn about the magic of the color red... / Pjesmica Crvena - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje...

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E46, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. R.: Mark Baker St.: John Sparkes (Narrator)... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E46, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s puno ljudskih osobina. Uz nju, tu su još njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Peppini prijatelji su njezinih godina, dok su prijatelji njezinog mlađeg brata njegovi vršnjaci. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. Likovi u seriji nose odjeću, žive u kućama i voze automobile, no pokazuju i neke osobine onih životinja na kojima su temeljeni. R.: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (Narator)...

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E18, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E18, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. R.: Julien Cayot Ul.: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)...

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: 123 Number Squad - (E33, drama series, Singapore, 2021) Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. R.: Sacha Goedegebure St.: Owen Crouch (Maurice / Redbeard), Marlon Dance-Hooi (Mr. Mengo / Farmer Haywire), Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)... / 123 Number Squad - (E33, igrana serija, Singapur, 2021) Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123. R.: Sacha Goedegebure Ul.: Owen Crouch (Maurice / Redbeard), Marlon Dance-Hooi (Mr. Mengo / Farmer Haywire), Amir El Ghouch (Numero / Tim), Archie Fletcher (Billy), Lois Sefton (Paula)...

programme.title: Pablo / Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo - (E05, feature series, England, 2017) The award-winning children's series "Pablo" was shot in 2D animation combined with feature parts. The main character, Pablo, is an artistically gifted five-year-old boy on the autism spectrum. His imaginative drawings come to life and allow him to face the real world with more confidence. With magic crayons, he bravely transforms his life challenges into fantastic adventures, and his feelings into picturesque, talking characters. With the help of his friends from the world of his drawings - Ljam, Noasaur, Misha, Rafi, Tango and Palča - Pablo understands his real world as a five-year-old more easily. "Pablo" pays tribute to individuality and thinking in a different way, as the first children's series in the world with an autistic main character. Each story depicts the real-life experiences of children with autism, who participated in creating the stories and writing the screenplay. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus), Rosie King (Llama), Sumita Majumdar (Wren)... / Pablo - (E05, igrana serija, Engleska, 2017) Nagrađivana serija za djecu "Pablo" snimljena je 2D animacijom u kombinaciji s igranim dijelovima. Glavni lik, Pablo, umjetnički je nadaren petogodišnji dječak u spektru autizma. Njegovi maštoviti crteži oživljavaju i omogućuju mu da se s više pouzdanja suočava sa stvarnim svijetom. Čarobnim bojicama on svoje životne izazove hrabro pretvara u fantastične pustolovine, a osjećaje u slikovite likove koji govore. Uz pomoć prijatelja iz svijeta svojih crteža - Ljamu, Noasaura, Mišu, Rafija, Tanga i Palči - Pablo lakše poima svoj stvarni svijet petogodišnjaka. "Pablo" odaje počast individualnosti i razmišljanju na drukčiji način, kao prva dječja serija na svijetu s autističnim glavnim likom. Svaka priča oslikava stvarna životna iskustva djece s autizmom, koja su sudjelovala u osmišljavanju priča i pisanju scenarija. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus), Rosie King (Llama), Sumita Majumdar (Wren)...
